stem: In the initial imaging assessment of a child with major trauma, which set of plain radiographs makes up the standard trauma series when imaging is required?

options.text: Lateral cervical spine, AP chest and AP pelvis radiographs
AP cervical spine, AP chest and AP pelvis radiographs
AP chest, AP pelvis and lateral right arm radiographs
CT head, CT cervical spine and CT abdomen
AP chest, lateral chest and abdominal radiographs

explanation: The plain trauma series in the initial trauma assessment classically includes a lateral cervical spine film, an AP chest radiograph and an AP pelvis radiograph. Limb radiographs are directed by findings after the primary survey, and CT is not a replacement for immediate resuscitation priorities.
